name: Molmo2-4B
notes: Small fully open Molmo2 on a Qwen3-4B backbone, same flags as Molmo2-8B. Weights are stored in 32-bit, so the download is about four times the 8-bit size. The 8B left no room for context on 20 GB; the 4B is about 4 GB smaller, so it is tried on 20 GB first. Resubmit on 40 GB if the KV cache is too small. Not yet run on BAM hardware.
status_note: Not run yet. Needs the weights on sv1223.
